definitions.explanation: The act of watching or monitoring someone or something closely.

examples.japanese: {防犯|ぼうはん}カメラで{監視|かんし}する。
{24時間|にじゅうよじかん}{監視|かんし}{体制|たいせい}。
{患者|かんじゃ}の{状態|じょうたい}を{監視|かんし}する。

notes:
{監視|かんし} means surveillance, monitoring, or watching over something/someone.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {監|かん}: oversee, supervise
- {視|し}: look, watch

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {監視|かんし}する: to monitor, to surveil
- {監視|かんし}カメラ: surveillance camera
- {監視|かんし}{下|か}に{置|お}く: to put under surveillance
- {監視|かんし}{体制|たいせい}: monitoring system
- {監視|かんし}{員|いん}: guard, watchman

CONTEXTS:
- Security: {防犯|ぼうはん}{監視|かんし} (crime prevention monitoring)
- Medical: {患者|かんじゃ}の{監視|かんし} (patient monitoring)
- IT: システム{監視|かんし} (system monitoring)
